title: Velvety Cod in Peppery Salad
description: A light and refreshing Chinese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared cod in a peppery salad.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a separate pan, toast some sesame seeds over low heat until fragrant.
In a large bowl, combine the peppery greens, cucumber, carrots, and celery.
Drizzle the velvety dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
To assemble the dish, place a cooked cod fillet on top of the salad and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds.
